study: PQ-1c: Agent Sessions variant against the plain baseline of design-review-execute
claims: measure-free figures only: no judge, no calibration, no quality claim, no claim about better

axes.completion: report run.status is completed with four committed typed results (provider or agent_turn commits of four identities)
axes.no_repeated_paid_work: every turn identity has one started row, and no log of the cell has an effect_rerun or agent_bootstrap_restarted line
axes.committed_turn_redispatched: a turn identity has a started row after its committed row
axes.usage_recorded: every provider attempt (an attempt directory holding prompt.txt) has a usage.json that is reported and complete
axes.cost: report run.usage.cost_usd, variant over baseline, per pair; a partial or unknown cost (cost_usd null, partial true or unknown_attempts above 0) or a zero baseline makes that pair's ratio undetermined, never a number
axes.invalidate: on a copy of each clean run, invalidate <run> <feedback identity>: the variant exits 2 with invalidate_coordinator_committed and unchanged run-tree bytes, the baseline exits 0; reported, decides no outcome
axes.elapsed_time: seconds of the run and resume invocations; reported, decides nothing

outcomes.Retire: a variant cell does not complete while its baseline cell does, or a committed turn of a variant cell is dispatched again, or the cost ratio is at or above 1.25 in both pairs
outcomes.Retain: all four cells complete, no paid work repeats in any cell, and the cost ratio is at or below 0.8 in both pairs
outcomes.Improve: anything else; Agent Sessions stays opt-in at target 2.38, the Python Agent item is not opened, and no further spend follows unless the consumer thread names a need

refusal: readout.py refuses to read out (exit 2, no outcome) when this file's SHA-256 differs from the hash it names, or when a cell recorded a different criterion hash
decision_order: invalid -> undetermined: a cell is missing; cells mix rehearsal and real runs; cells differ in runtime commit, fixture commit or source digest of an arm; a real cell ran on a runtime with uncommitted changes; a recorded usage model or bound model input is not claude-haiku-5-5; the wrapper stopped a resumed cell with a turn in flight or elsewhere than right after the reviewer's first turn (a run that ends before the stop is filed as it stands and counts for completion)
Retire by completion or a redispatched committed variant turn, whatever the cost
Retire by cost when both ratios are known and at or above 1.25
undetermined when a ratio is unknown and the known ratios do not already exclude Retire by cost
Retain when all cells complete, nothing repeats and both ratios are known and at or below 0.8
undetermined when completion and no repetition hold and a ratio is unknown that could still give Retain
can_decide: a cost difference outside the 0.8 to 1.25 band
cannot_decide: a cost difference inside the band
owner_judgment: whether what was observed justifies losing the ability to invalidate feedback
